# Questions retired for missing figures (7 November 2026)

These 191 active questions referred to a graph, chart or diagram that was lost before import. Only an empty
`|  |` placeholder remained, and no matching image exists in `private.question_assets`, in a duplicate question, or in
the repository. They were retired so students stop receiving unanswerable questions. Attempts and other history are kept.

- 156 Reading and Writing "data from the graph" questions (`rw-ii-evidence`)
- 29 triangle questions (`m-geo-trig`, `m-geo-lines`)
- 6 bar graph or histogram questions (`m-psda-onevar`)

To bring one back, first add its figure to `stem_md`, then set it active again:

```sql
update public.questions set status = 'active' where id in ('...');
```

The original import ZIP may hold the figures; `scripts/repair-import.mts` reads that format.
